description: This file defines a PHP class 'SampleXMLRPCServer' that extends an XMLRPC server for the TestLink project. It implements methods for retrieving test suite IDs by name and uploading statistics, utilizing internal services like 'tsuiteMgr' and 'tprojectMgr'. The class is designed to handle remote procedure calls (RPC) related to test management.

classes.name: SampleXMLRPCServer
classes.description: A subclass of TestlinkXMLRPCServer that provides additional RPC methods for test management, including retrieving test suite IDs by name and uploading system statistics.

methods.name: getTestSuiteIDByName
methods.description: Public method to retrieve the test suite ID given its name, performing necessary checks and invoking internal methods.

methods.name: uploadStats
methods.description: Public method to log system statistics received via RPC, storing or processing them as needed.

methods.name: _getTestSuiteByName
methods.description: Private helper method that fetches test suite data by name and validates its association with a specific project.
